pattern.description: A close-up of the rook with grey move-hint dots snaps out to a wider view of the illustrated board corner. The move dots clear, then a gold star pops above the rook and bursts into a dashed ring of particles that fades around the piece as the frame settles.
pattern.why_premium: Fast, snappy reframes keep the tutorial lively without a camera move, and the star-to-particle-ring reward reuses Duolingo's own success feedback, so the tutorial already feels like the product.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to(boardGroup, {scale: 0.6, x: 120, y: 60, duration: 0.2, ease: 'power3.out'}); tl.to(moveDots, {autoAlpha: 0, duration: 0.08}, '<'); tl.fromTo(star, {scale: 0, autoAlpha: 0}, {scale: 1, autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.12, ease: 'back.out(3)'}); tl.to(star, {scale: 0.2, autoAlpha: 0, duration: 0.08, ease: 'power2.in'}); tl.fromTo(ringDots, {scale: 0.4, autoAlpha: 1}, {scale: 1.2, autoAlpha: 0, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.out', stagger: {each: 0.01, from: 'random'}}, '<'); tl.fromTo(rook, {y: 0}, {y: -6, duration: 0.06, yoyo: true, repeat: 1, ease: 'sine.out'}, '<');
build_hint.remotion: Board scale/translate with interpolate(frame, [0, 6], [1, 0.6], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic)}); star scale via spring({frame: frame - 13, fps, config: {damping: 8, stiffness: 400, mass: 0.6}}) then fade over 3 frames; ring dots radius = interpolate(frame - 15, [0, 9], [20, 70]) with opacity 1->0; rook hop translateY = -6 * Math.sin(Math.PI * clamp((frame - 14) / 4)).

notes: The energy curve has a near-zero dip mid-burst (frames 590/591), so the board reframes may be hard jump-cuts between framings rather than one continuous zoom; camera.move is 'none', so this is reported as a content re-layout, not a camera move. Grey move-hint dots disappear but have no position on the end frame, so they are not listed separately. Rook and star/ring use manual boxes (only b01 offered). No SFX candidates.
